name: GT Development 01
description: Synthetic track coupe with selected published specification anchors. It is not a calibrated replica of the source vehicle.

sources.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS technical data · EU · August 2022
fields: seven gear ratios and final drive

assumptions: The 1,400 kg base mass excludes fuel and is an independent estimate. It is not the source vehicle's 1,450 kg DIN unladen mass.
Fixed 2.2 m² downforce area, 1.35 tyre friction, 2.1 g braking cap and 0.36 m loaded wheel radius are estimates. Active aero is omitted.
Only the 6,300 and 8,500 RPM power points are specification anchors. Other curve points and 1,000 RPM idle are estimates; shifts have no interruption.
